line: Managed vector database for semantic search, metadata filtering and hybrid retrieval.

sql.math: 100K queries + 10K upserts (adding or updating vectors) cost $0.44. 0.7168 GB of raw vectors and metadata adds $0.1792. The total is $0.6192, before index overhead.
